title: My Closet
subtitle: A digital closet feature showing customers the apparel they already own — built to increase Member engagement in record time.

intro.paragraph: My Closet was a digital feature designed to show customers their purchased apparel, leveraging existing purchase history data to increase engagement and drive repeat visits.

challenge: How might we bring back our customers using clothes they already own?

goals.goal: Increase engagement (return rate, session length, pages/session)
Promote sustainability via building on existing apparel
